annotation: Single annotator (the AI assistant that built PRISM), document-level judgements made by reading each title+abstract. Queries were written after reading the abstracts, so scores are optimistic. 16 queries, not expert-validated: treat as a smoke test of retrieval behaviour, not a benchmark.
